current_receipts.scope: current worker-jobs only, not archive; no task names, IDs or payload values emitted

method: Selected deployed own function source segments and checkout source segments parsed by the same interpreter, without comparing decorators. No proprietary source, task names, identifiers, media, descriptions, transcripts or vectors are retained.

findings.claim: Existing speech results were HTTP-accepted at the fixed speech callback.
findings.basis: 64 completed speechToText receipts since container start, reviewed matching _normalize_speech_to_text/_execute_speech/_post_callback bodies, and exact fixed-route constant check.
findings.limitations: HTTP 2xx proves endpoint acceptance, not saved/searchable enrichment. The bounded current journal has 67 callback_uncertain records and one callback_sending record, which are not successes. No new media export, transcription, model job or callback was initiated.

findings.claim: The existing NL_PARSE query handler uses the querySentence field in its stated request/result context.
findings.basis: Eight successful encoding paths counted on the existing search connection. The deployed query dispatch/result construction was reviewed against search.py; differences are diagnostic record_query calls and reply instrumentation, not these field names. Historical native retrieval is recorded in find-anything-contract.md.
findings.limitations: Seven query failures remain recorded. An encoding counter alone is not native retrieval acceptance; the historical own-controller positive/negative retrieval is separate. Optional output fields are not claimed mandatory.
